title: Cross-state representation learning enables prospective discovery of dynamic protein allosteric sites
summary: AllositeUltra, a deep-learning framework for allosteric site detection, reached Top-3 site recovery of 65.2% on apo and 70.6% on substrate-bound structures, versus the best baselines. Prospective application to MAGI2 identified an interdomain allosteric pocket, validated by small-molecule screening and X-ray crystallography at atomic resolution.
ai_technology: AllositeUltra (structure-aware protein language model combined with physical dynamics; residue-guided candidate supplementation)
organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: The predicted MAGI2 interdomain pocket was validated experimentally through small-molecule screening and X-ray crystallography; benchmark recovery was measured on apo and substrate-bound structures.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material beyond the abstract; the number of prospective candidates tested is not given in the abstract.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model predicted allosteric sites on apo and substrate-bound structures and was applied prospectively to MAGI2 and proteome-wide.
